display.purpose: Page-level headings only. One per view, at the top of the content area. Never in cards.

headline.purpose: Section headings within a page. Recipe names in detail view.

title.purpose: Card titles, dialog headings, modal headers.

body.purpose: Default text for descriptions, form content, table cells. Also used for button labels with weight 700 override.

label.purpose: Form field labels and input group headings only. Not section kickers.

mono.purpose: All currency values, quantities, costs, margins, percentages. Tabular-nums enabled.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Default card shadow. Lifts Recipe Card off Apron White. Dark mode: 0.4 opacity.

shadows.name: ambient-mid
shadows.purpose: Elevated card shadow. Hover states, sign-in cards, stats cards.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, modals, and the mobile sidebar. Surfaces that demand full attention.

shadows.name: accent-tint
shadows.value: 0 8px 30px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--aw-accent-500) 18%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--aw-accent-500) 8%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Landing page accent-tinted shadow. Draws attention to featured cards. Dark mode: 30%/12% opacity.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions (hover, focus, active). Used on buttons, inputs, cards.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Landing page scroll reveals and card hover transitions.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift. 250ms duration via ease-out.

narrative.overview:
A professional kitchen at mise-en-place: every ingredient weighed, every tool in reach, every surface clean. The design system serves cooks who need numbers fast. It trades decoration for clarity, but never at the cost of warmth. The interface feels like a well-organized prep station — where the stainless steel counter (the data) is framed by wooden cutting boards (the containers) under warm task lighting (the accent).

This is a product UI for food entrepreneurs running real businesses. It rejects SaaS-cream genericism, enterprise coldness, and playful-food-app infantilism.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers own the page — costs and quantities in tabular mono, framed by restrained sans
Flat tonal layering — depth comes from background shifts, not shadow stacks
Tactile, responsive components — buttons press down, cards lift on hover
Accent as signal, not decoration — indigo appears only on primary actions
Dark mode through token remapping, not CSS overrides

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent color is used on primary actions, current selection, and focus indicators only. It never decorates. Its rarity on the page is what makes it signal.

rules.name: The Token Bridge Rule
rules.body: Every color is a semantic token referencing a CSS variable. Never hardcode a hex or oklch value in a component.

rules.name: The Data Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: Every dollar amount, every gram, every percentage renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums enabled. The font shift signals 'this is data, not prose.'

rules.name: The One Label Rule
rules.body: The tracked-uppercase label style appears on form field labels and input group headings only. It does not appear above sections or as decorative kickers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover, focus, or elevation into overlay territory.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: In the absence of shadows, depth is tonal: background → card → muted. Each step is a distinct background color, perceptible in both modes.

dos: Do use semantic color tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, border-border) everywhere.
Do render all currency and quantity values in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do use min-h-11 (44px) on all interactive touch targets.
Do apply transform: scale(0.97) on button :active states.
Do convey depth through background color shifts first, shadows only at elevated interaction points.
Do use rounded-xl for buttons/inputs, rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-3xl for dialogs.
Do animate with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for state transitions at 150–250ms.
donts: Don't use SaaS-cream patterns: no white cards on pale gradients, no purple CTAs, no hero-metric templates.
Don't use enterprise-cold patterns: no dense Jira tables, no monospace everywhere, no ERP jargon.
Don't use playful-food-app patterns: no cartoon vegetables, no rounded-everything, no rainbow palettes.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use glassmorphism as default card treatment.
Don't reach for a modal before exhausting inline/progressive alternatives.
Don't use identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly.
Don't write .dark CSS selector overrides — the token system handles dark mode automatically.
Don't animate CSS layout properties — use transform and opacity only.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
